title: Electrification of fertilizer production via plasma-based nitrogen fixation: a tutorial on fundamentals
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,757-780
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00726C, Tutorial Review

Mikhail Gromov, Yury Gorbanev, Elise Vervloessem, Rino Morent, Rony Snyders, Nathalie De Geyter, Annemie Bogaerts, Anton Nikiforov
Plasma-based nitrogen fixation, leveraging non-thermal plasma technologies, offers a promising alternative to conventional processes, with the potential to decentralize fertilizer production, reduce CO2 emissions, and employ renewable energy sources.
